mapper.select: SELECT id AS activityId, title, description, cover, original_price AS originalPrice, seckill_price AS seckillPrice, total_stock AS totalStock, available_stock AS availableStock, per_user_limit AS perUserLimit, status, begin_time AS beginTime, end_time AS endTime, pay_timeout_minutes AS payTimeoutMinutes, version FROM trade_activity WHERE id = #{activityId}

SELECT id AS activityId, title, description, cover, original_price AS originalPrice, seckill_price AS seckillPrice, total_stock AS totalStock, available_stock AS availableStock, per_user_limit AS perUserLimit, status, begin_time AS beginTime, end_time AS endTime, pay_timeout_minutes AS payTimeoutMinutes, version FROM trade_activity WHERE status = 'published' AND end_time > #{now} ORDER BY CASE WHEN begin_time <= #{now} AND end_time > #{now} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, begin_time ASC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM trade_activity WHERE status = 'published' AND end_time > #{now}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_activity ( id, title, description, cover, original_price, seckill_price, total_stock, available_stock, per_user_limit, status, begin_time, end_time, pay_timeout_minutes, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{title}, #{description}, #{cover}, #{originalPrice}, #{seckillPrice}, #{totalStock}, #{totalStock}, #{perUserLimit}, 'published', #{beginTime}, #{endTime}, #{payTimeoutMinutes}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.activity_id AS activityId, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, o.quantity, o.amount, o.status, o.pay_channel AS payChannel, o.order_time AS orderTime, o.expire_at AS expireAt, o.pay_time AS payTime, o.close_time AS closeTime, o.close_reason AS closeReason, a.title AS activityTitle, a.cover AS activityCover FROM trade_order o INNER JOIN trade_activity a ON a.id = o.activity_id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo}

SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.activity_id AS activityId, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, o.quantity, o.amount, o.status, o.pay_channel AS payChannel, o.order_time AS orderTime, o.expire_at AS expireAt, o.pay_time AS payTime, o.close_time AS closeTime, o.close_reason AS closeReason, a.title AS activityTitle, a.cover AS activityCover FROM trade_order o INNER JOIN trade_activity a ON a.id = o.activity_id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND o.buyer_id = #{buyerId}

SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.activity_id AS activityId, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, o.quantity, o.amount, o.status, o.pay_channel AS payChannel, o.order_time AS orderTime, o.expire_at AS expireAt, o.pay_time AS payTime, o.close_time AS closeTime, o.close_reason AS closeReason, a.title AS activityTitle, a.cover AS activityCover FROM trade_order o INNER JOIN trade_activity a ON a.id = o.activity_id WHERE o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} ORDER BY o.order_time DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_order ( id, order_no, activity_id, buyer_id, quantity, amount, status, order_time, expire_at, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{orderNo}, #{activityId}, #{buyerId}, #{quantity}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{orderTime}, #{expireAt}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE trade_order SET status = 'CLOSED', close_time = #{now}, close_reason = #{closeReason}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND expire_at <= #{now}
mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.activity_id AS activityId, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, o.quantity, o.amount, o.status, o.pay_channel AS payChannel, o.order_time AS orderTime, o.expire_at AS expireAt, o.pay_time AS payTime, o.close_time AS closeTime, o.close_reason AS closeReason, a.title AS activityTitle, a.cover AS activityCover FROM trade_order o INNER JOIN trade_activity a ON a.id = o.activity_id WHERE o.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND o.expire_at <= #{now} ORDER BY o.expire_at ASC, o.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.activity_id AS activityId, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, o.quantity, o.amount, o.status, o.pay_channel AS payChannel, o.order_time AS orderTime, o.expire_at AS expireAt, o.pay_time AS payTime, o.close_time AS closeTime, o.close_reason AS closeReason, a.title AS activityTitle, a.cover AS activityCover FROM trade_order o INNER JOIN trade_activity a ON a.id = o.activity_id WHERE o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} AND o.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND o.expire_at <= #{now} ORDER BY o.expire_at ASC, o.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox ( id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, 'pending', 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT id, aggregate_id AS aggregateId, payload FROM outbox WHERE aggregate_type = 'trade_order' AND event_type = 'trade_redis_sync' AND status IN ('pending', 'failed') AND retry_count < 10 ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox SET status = 'published', published_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
